catalog_course_description: Basic Turkish II is acontinuation of TUR 101 and aims to help foreign students further develop basic level grammar and oral skills and to raise their awareness of processes involved in effective communication.
course_objective: This course is designed for students who have completed the A1 level and will continue developing basic communication skills in everyday situations. The aim is to enable students to understand and use frequently used expressions related to areas of most immediate relevance (e.g., personal and family information, shopping, local geography, employment). Students will be able to describe experiences, events, dreams, and ambitions and give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans in simple terms. Alongside language, the course provides cultural insight into Turkish traditions, customs, and everyday life. The approach is communicative, with Turkish used as much as possible as the language of instruction.

resources: Coursebook & workbook: “Yeni İstanbul Uluslararası Öğrenciler İçin Türkçe Eğitim Seti A1” – Kültür Sanat Basımevi “Yeni İstanbul Uluslararası Öğrenciler İçin Türkçe Eğitim Seti A2” – Kültür Sanat Basımevi
